yamlCheck.dateAnchor: April 13 is independently spoken at u0722–u0724. The next-day transitions establish April 14 and 15, and the preceding evening is April 12. The year and the March 22 starting boundary come from YAML; the anniversary and Rebirth are only relatively dated here.
yamlCheck.explanation: The assessed adventure interval includes earlier camp downtime and the enacted ship farewell. The opening is nearly a month after the dragon fight; party language practice is two-ish weeks and Faldrak’s overlapping practice three weeks. These approximations and the farewell/travel do not establish an exact total. Three successive evening/morning transitions from April 12 to 15 are supported. The March 22 start is not contradicted, but all 24 boundaries are not independently verified. Ten-day visas and future market/approval forecasts add no elapsed time.
